<quote by="Announced by Elsha Bertolf, Chair of the Wolf">Commission a business sinecure, The Garrison of the League, in Hanuri in Temeschwar. Appointed by League Generals annually. </quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a sinecure in [[Temeschwar]]
* Announcement by the [[Chair of the Wolf]]
==Date==
* Summer 385YE
==Cost==
* Standard costs apply (minimum)

* 3 months to construct
